item.text: The exporter stops when a page has fewer live records than `pageSize`, even if a continuation cursor exists. Deleted records trigger that early stop. Projects hide the bug by forcing a larger page size. I’ll make pagination follow cursors until `null` and remove the project workaround.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Exports now follow continuation cursors until `null`, including after short or empty pages. The reported invoice case now includes both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Removed the project page-size workaround so projects respect the requested `pageSize`.

All 5 tests pass, including regression coverage for deleted records and empty-string cursors.
